arabic text: HAAYE ZEHRA TERI TANHAI HEY, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text: Alas, Zahra—your loneliness became Ali’s loneliness.

arabic text:
HAAYE GHAM MEY TEREY JAATI RAHI
BEENAYI ALI KI
TERI TANHAI HEY, TANHAI ALI KI
HAAYE ZEHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text:
Alas, in your grief Ali’s
eyesight faded. Your loneliness became
Ali’s loneliness. Alas, Zahra—your
loneliness became Ali’s loneliness.

arabic text:
DARBAR MEY ZAALIM KAY GAYEE BINTEY PAYAMBAR
KYA WAQT THA KUCH KAR NA SAKA FAATEH E KHAIBER
HAAYE HASTEY RAHEY GHURBAT PEY TAMASHAYEE ALI
KI
TERI TANHAI HEY, TANHAI ALI KI
HAAYE ZEHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text:
The Prophet’s daughter went before
the tyrant’s court. What a
moment: the Conqueror of Khaybar
could do nothing. Spectators laughed
at Ali’s helplessness. Your
loneliness became Ali’s loneliness.

arabic text:
PAIGHAM E WILAYAT LIYE GHAR GHAR GAYEE ZEHRA
SHOHAR KAY LIYE DHAAL THI JAB TAK RAHEE ZINDA
HAAYE DUNYA KO BATATEE RAHEE SACHAAYEE ALI KI
TERI TANHAI HEY, TANHAI ALI KI
HAAYE ZEHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text:
Carrying the message of wilayah, Zahra went from
door to door. As long as she
lived, she was a shield for her
husband. She kept telling the world of
Ali’s truth. Your loneliness became Ali’s loneliness.

arabic text:
KEHTEY THAY ALI ZEHRA SEY KYA HAAL HEY BIBI
AB HUM KO SALAM AAKEY KARTA NAHI KOI
HAAYE HEY BAADE NABI KAISEE PAZEERAYEE ALI KI
TERI TANHAI HEY, TANHAI ALI KI
HAAYE ZEHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text:
Ali would ask Zahra, ‘How are
you, my Lady? No one now
comes to greet us.’ Alas, what
a welcome Ali received after the
Prophet. Your loneliness became Ali’s loneliness.

arabic text:
DAR JALTA HUAA FATEMA ZEHRA PEY GIRAAYA
MOHSIN KI SHAHADAT KA SABAB BANGAYEE DUNIYA
HAAYE TASVEER MUKAMMAL NAHEE HO PAYEE ALI KI
TERI TANHAI HEY, TANHAI ALI KI
HAAYE ZEHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text:
The burning door was pushed upon
Fatima Zahra. The world became the
cause of Mohsin’s martyrdom. Alas, Ali’s
family portrait could never be completed.
Your loneliness became Ali’s loneliness.

arabic text:
BAAHAR KABHI HUJREY MEY KABHI QABREY NABI PAR
HAR RAAT KI TAREEKI MEY AULAAD SEY CHUP KAR
HAAYE NIKLI HEY TUJHEY DHOONDNEY BEENAYI ALI KI
TERI TANHAI HEY, TANHAI ALI KI
HAAYE ZEHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text:
Sometimes outside, sometimes in the room, sometimes
at the Prophet’s grave—in the darkness of
every night, hidden from the children, Ali’s
fading sight went out searching for
you. Your loneliness became Ali’s loneliness.

arabic text:
ZAHRA KI JUDAI KO LAGAYE HUEY DIL SEY
PACHEES BARAS MAULA NEY CHUP CHAAP GUZAREY
HAAYE EK HUJREY MEY KUL DUNYA SIMAT AAYEE ALI KI
TERI TANHAI HEY, TANHAI ALI KI
HAAYE ZEHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
english translation text:
Holding Zahra’s separation within his heart,
the Maula passed twenty-five years in
silence. In one small room, Ali’s
entire world had been contained.
Your loneliness became Ali’s loneliness.

arabic text:
US WAQT TAKALLUM WO ZAMANEY KA WALI THA
SAJJAD JO ZAINAB KO LIYE SHAAM SEY GUZRA
HAAYE ISLAM KO KHAMOSHI BACHA LAAYEE ALI KI
TERI TANHAI HEY, TANHAI ALI KI
HAAYE ZEHRA TERI TANHAI HAI, TANHAI ALI KI
TANHAI ALI KI…
english translation text:
Takallum, at that time he
was the guardian of the
age—Sajjad, who carried Zainab
through Shaam. Ali’s silence
preserved Islam. Your loneliness
became Ali’s loneliness—Ali’s loneliness.
